Definition: Sanballat, a Persian satrap of Samaria
BiblicalUsage: Sanballat the Horonite was the governor of Samaria who opposed Nehemiah at every step, mocking the builders, then plotting against them, then trying to lure Nehemiah away. He appears through the whole rebuilding, from the first hearing of the news to the finished wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe opposition to God's work is nothing new, and Sanballat shows it plainly: when God moves, someone always tries to stop it.
